label: Sword & Shield
note: MH4U endgame elemental SnS is built on Honed Blade (Sharpness +1 + Attack Up L), Razor Sharp, the matching [Element] Atk +3 (1.15x + 90), and Evasion +1/+2; Challenger +2 (+25 true raw/+20% affinity while enraged) is the usual conditional damage swap. Optimized sets often take [Element] Atk +3 instead of generic Element Atk Up (1.1x), but this model has only the generic multiplier, so elementAttackUp is 1.1 and the +3 skill's flat +90 is not represented. Status SnS instead runs Status Atk +2 (1.2x + 10) with Bombardier. The preset models Honed Blade's always-on components (sharpness 'best' = Sharpness +1, attackUp 20 = Attack Up L); Honed Blade as a combined skill, Razor Sharp, Evasion, Status Atk, [Element] Atk +3, Challenger +2's enraged effects, Weakness Exploit (+5 hitzone), Bombardier, and Elemental Crit are unmodeled. The shared sharpness table uses MHFU raw multipliers; MH4U uses 1.05 green / 1.20 blue / 1.32 white / 1.45 purple, so absolute scores are not directly comparable across games.
